description: This file contains unit tests for a memoization utility in the webkitpy project, including a test class for memoized functions and various test cases.

classes.name: _TestObject
classes.description: A test class that demonstrates the use of the memoized decorator, tracking call count and adding one to arguments.

classes.name: MemoizedTest
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase class containing tests for the memoized method behavior, including repeated calls, different arguments, reassignments, and unhashable arguments.

methods.name: memoized_add_one
methods.description: A memoized method that adds one to its argument and increments call count.

methods.name: test_multiple_identical_calls
methods.description: Tests that repeated calls with the same argument do not increase call count.

methods.name: test_different_calls
methods.description: Tests that calls with different arguments increase call count accordingly.

methods.name: test_reassign_function
methods.description: Tests that the memoized method can be assigned to a variable and still functions correctly.

methods.name: test_non_hashable_args
methods.description: Tests that passing a non-hashable argument raises a TypeError.
